messages:
dana: Heads up — proposing a 3-hour soft embargo for the overnight change window tomorrow 22:00 UTC -> 01:00 UTC. Plan: canary deploy v2.18.0 with staggered traffic shifts. Need owners for canary metrics, rollback criteria, and release-note pin. Proposing traffic holdpoints at +15m and +60m. Any objections?

mike: +1. I can own canary metrics (latency, 95p, error-rate). Suggest rollback if error-rate >= 2x baseline sustained for 3m or p95 latency > 200ms. Will set dashboards.

sre-oncall: Prefer automatic rollback on error-rate >= 1.5x baseline sustained for 3m OR CPU > 90% for 10m. Manual rollback always allowed. I'll stand by with runbook ready.

liz: I'll own release notes pin and customer comms. Need final release note copy by 21:00 UTC so I can pin and queue the heads-up. Also request freezing non-critical experiments (esp. embeddings A/B) during the window.

raj: FYI infra saw a sporadic NFS flake in staging earlier today after a kernel tweak. We rolled back that kernel but will monitor pod eviction / attach errors. If we see similar patterns, pause traffic shift immediately.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary start requested by @mike for release v2.18.0 on prod-canary at 22:05 UTC. Status: scheduled. To cancel: `/deploy cancel 3222223333`.

sarah: Quick question — payment hotfix (tiny migration) is queued and needs to ship before midnight if approved. Any special exemption process?

dana: For micro-hotfixes: require eng-sre + product signoff. If critical (payment), we can route a staged hotfix to the dedicated pool and avoid full traffic shift, but must still follow rollback thresholds. @sre-oncall @liz please confirm.

sre-oncall: Approve staged hotfix to dedicated pool with standard monitoring. No relaxed thresholds. Label PR `emergency/hotfix` and include short rollback plan.

mike: Will run canary and post metrics at +15m. If thresholds hit, I will trigger rollback with `/deploy rollback --to=2.17.5 --reason="canary latency spike"`.

dana: Final checklist (quick): owners — canary: mike; rollback/runbook: sre-oncall; comms: liz. Release notes by 21:00. Traffic shifts at +15m and +60m. Soft embargo: no non-critical changes during window. Infra standby: raj. Everyone OK?

liz: :thumbsup: comms locked, release note draft sent to dana, will pin at 21:00.

raj: I'll be on standby 21:30-01:30 UTC, will watch kernel/pv attach logs. If I see pod evictions spike, I'll call for hold.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary started at 22:05 UTC — running. Monitor: https://grafana.redwood/canary/3222223333

sarah: Thanks — prepping the payment hotfix PR for eng-sre review now.

dana: Locking thread for the freeze window. Post any last-minute changes here; otherwise proceeding as planned. GL everyone.
